question: Annie Besant was associated with which of the following socio-religious movement?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Annie Besant:-**

 
 
• She was a prominent British socialist, women's rights activist, and supporter of Indian self-rule.
 
• She became associated with the Theosophical Society in 1889 and eventually became its leader in 1907.
 
 
 
• **Theosophical Society:-**
 
 
• It was a spiritual movement that aimed to promote universal brotherhood, study of ancient wisdom traditions, and exploration of psychic and spiritual phenomena.
 
• Besant's involvement with the Theosophical Society led her to become interested in Indian spirituality and culture, and she eventually became a prominent supporter of Indian independence. Solution:
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Indian Reform Association:-**

 
 
• It was founded by Keshab Chandra Sen in 1870 and aimed to promote social reforms in India.
 
 
 
• **Tattvabodhini Sabha:-**
 
 
• It was founded by Debendranath Tagore in 1839 and focused on the study of Hindu scriptures and philosophy.
 
 
 
• **Adi Brahmo Samaj:-**
 
 
• After the splitting of Brahmo samaj, Devendranath Tagore founded Adi Brahmo Samaj in 1866.
